response.record_grain: One row per NPI facility record, keyed by the national facility_id; jurisdiction_code + jurisdiction_facility_id is the state-scoped facility identifier pair.
response.grain_rationale: Byte inspection shows a single header row of 22 flat scalar fields with no nested arrays, so one row is one facility. facility_id is the nationally unique NPI facility identifier; jurisdiction_facility_id is only unique within jurisdiction_code and must never be used alone. Operator identity (registered_business_name, abn, acn) repeats across facility rows and is a separate business role, not a facility key.

record_id.rationale: facility_id is the national NPI facility identifier and is unique across jurisdictions; jurisdiction_code + jurisdiction_facility_id is retained as the state-scoped identifier pair but is not needed for the record key.

fields.rationale: facility_id is the national NPI facility identifier, unique across jurisdictions; establishment-owned, not the operator's ABN/ACN.

State-scoped NPI facility identifier; only unique within its jurisdiction, so the jurisdiction_code qualifier is carried with every claim. The qualifier is passed through verbatim (trim+upper only, no enum mapping) so it is never dropped, including for non-state codes such as 'COM'.

NPI registration jurisdiction of the facility, kept as a free string (trim+upper only, no enum mapping) because the source contains non-state codes such as 'COM' that a closed AU state enum would silently drop. Distinct from the business address state and required as the qualifier for the jurisdiction-scoped facility id.
facility_name is the site/premises name; it is not unique and must not be conflated with registered_business_name.
latitude/longitude are facility coordinates; geo_point validates the pair lies inside Australia. Values may be rounded and do not assert exact site boundaries.
street_address is the facility site street address; establishment-owned site address claim, not the operator's registered office.
suburb is the facility site locality; establishment-owned, not the operator's registered locality.

state is the facility site address state; establishment-owned. The NPI registration jurisdiction is captured separately as dyn.establishment.jurisdiction_code. For the observed rows state equals jurisdiction_code, but the two are not guaranteed equal (the 'COM' jurisdiction case shows they can diverge), so they are kept as separate concepts.

postcode is the facility site postcode; establishment-owned. The postcode transform validates a 4-digit AU postcode and may re-pad 3-digit NT codes; the observed rows are all 4-digit strings, so the re-padding branch is not evidenced here and is not claimed as observed behaviour.
Facility-level primary ANZSIC class code as stated by NPI; describes the facility, not the company-wide industry, so it stays establishment-owned.
Facility-level ANZSIC class label in the publisher's wording; not promoted to the operator.
Free-text facility activity statement kept verbatim; not converted into an invented industry code.
NPI reporting-year label of the first report; not an incorporation or licence date.
NPI reporting-year label of the most recent report; not a compliance or licence date.
Count of NPI reports for the facility; a report count, not an emissions measure or compliance indicator.
NPI identifier of the most recent report; identifies the report, not the facility.

Published report link only; embeds state/year/jurisdiction-facility path segments and is not a stable facility identifier. The website transform is a basic URL sanity check; the observed emitted values preserve the full path (e.g. .../criteria/state/SA/year/2025/jurisdiction-facility/SA0152), so the link-only semantics hold for the observed rows.

registered_business_name is the operator's registered business name as published, not the facility name. It is not mapped to entity.legal_name because for individuals/partnerships (e.g. 'A C PENTECOST', 'A L & A K BOSSE') a registered business name is not a registered company legal name; this concept keeps the claim scope to 'registered business name as published' and asserts no legal form.
Operator ABN; checksum-validated, blank treated as missing. Presence of an ABN does not imply a particular legal form.

Operator ACN; frequently blank and not derived from the ABN. The acn transform checks the checksum and raises ACN_CHECKSUM for invalid values; those values are NOT emitted as valid ACNs (they are recorded as value errors, which is why they appear in error_examples), so the emitted set is checksum-valid only.

The column is named facility_website and observed domains can mismatch the registered business name (e.g. a group domain published against a differently named operator), so this is kept as an establishment-owned 'published facility website' claim and is not asserted to be the operator's own website.

operator.rationale: The registered business name plus ABN/ACN identify the operator entity, which repeats across facility rows; it is a separate business role from the facility establishment. Known limitation: keys join raw trimmed values with no normalization, and ACN is frequently blank (and invalid ACNs are dropped), so the same operator can produce different entity_refs across rows (one with ACN, one without). This fragmentation is documented, not hidden; ABN alone would be more stable but is also not always present.

establishment.rationale: The NPI facility is a physical operating site identified by the national facility_id; it is distinct from the operator business that reports for it.

relationships.rationale: Each NPI facility row states the registered business that operates the facility; the operator is a business role and the facility an establishment role.

response.notes: All 22 columns are read. state is mapped to dyn.establishment.state for the facility site address while jurisdiction_code is captured separately as the NPI registration jurisdiction (free string, no enum mapping, so 'COM' is preserved); the two are near-duplicates for the observed rows but are not guaranteed equal. facility_id is the record key; jurisdiction_facility_id is only unique within jurisdiction_code and is never used alone. registered_business_name/abn/acn belong to the operator business role, not the facility; no legal form or entity_type is inferred from names or ABN presence. registered_business_name is mapped to dyn.business.registered_business_name, not entity.legal_name, because a registered business name is not a registered company legal name. facility_website is mapped to establishment-owned dyn.establishment.published_website, not entity.website, because the domain may be a group/facility site. first_report_year/latest_report_year are NPI reporting-year labels, not incorporation or licence dates. primary_anzsic_class_* describe the facility's primary activity, not a company-wide industry classification. reports is a report count, not an emissions measure, and the facilities table alone does not evidence emissions or environmental compliance. latest_report_url is a link, not a stable identifier. observed_at has no publisher-stated modification column, so the resource_last_modified fallback resolves to retrieved_at (2026-11-22T22:37:19+00:00): this is observation-at-retrieval, not a publisher-stated update. No constants are used.
